owner_policy_lock.minimum_input_rule: Never wait for a preselected venue, tomorrow's card, odds, or any other non-essential input when another still-unstarted race has the frozen model's trustworthy PRE fields available.
owner_policy_lock.target_selection_rule: Continuously scan across venues and races. First compute the cheap strict competition gate; spend full PRE-freeze/prediction work only on races that pass the frozen 0.40 gate.
owner_policy_lock.odds_rule: Prediction and raw required-odds thresholds are produced without actual odds. Actual odds are checked only later for execution-price/realized-ROI claims and must then be genuine pre-close observations.
owner_policy_lock.handoff_requirement: Every future KEIRIN handoff must preserve target-agnostic venue switching and the no-odds-block rule. Do not regress to waiting on Sasebo, Matsuyama, or any named venue.
